title: The voyage on the SS Oriente
summary: A hurricane stretched the trip to six days; he made friends among the merchant marines.

blocks.x: Okay, ahh - I understand you were on the SS. Oriente.
How long did it take you to get here from Cuba?
Ahh!! - that was a trip!! , because there was a hurricane and it was practically three days and we...
Because got to go around the hurricane or whatever, all around. I got sea-sick.
Is there anything of significance that happened on that trip? Did you meet anybody of importance or did anything happened on that trip?

I met a lot of people that I am - then - they became my friends, people working, you know, merchant marines. They helped me tremendously and we became friends and when I got here in New York, I had friends already.
Okay. Before you left Cuba, had you already known Marcelino Guerra?
